# tomswallapi_portgroup (Resource)

A reusable proto+ports combination referenced by rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_portgroup" "https" {
  name  = "https"
  proto = "tcp"
  ports = ["443"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Portgroup name (globally unique).
- `ports` (List of String) Ports or port ranges, e.g. ["80", "443", "1024-65535"].
- `proto` (String) Protocol, e.g. tcp or udp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name.
terraform import tomswallapi_portgroup.https https
```
